questoes.capitulo: Leitura: rotina escolar (texto lacunado)
questoes.texto:
My name is Peter. I'm 14 years old and I go to Hamlet School 1.____ weekdays.

My classes start 2.____ 8:30 AM.

My favorite 3.____ are Geography and 4.____, but I don't really like 5.____. I'm not interested in the past events.

At school, I usually spend time in the 6.____ because I love science.

I also go to the 7.____ on Mondays for P.E. class.

We have many rules at school. We 8.____ wear our school uniform every day. We 9.____ wear jeans at school.

We have to arrive on time, but we don't have to stay after school unless there is an activity.

Our summer vacation is 10.____ June and July. I love spending this time traveling!
